1063.description: A wide-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It hits the glutes and inner thighs along with the quads.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet well wider than your shoulders.
Turn your toes out about 30 degrees.
Brace your core and sit down between your legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend to thigh level or lower, then push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

1127.description: A strap-based pull-up variation that builds the lats and arms, with an angled body you can adjust.
instructions: Hold the handles overhead and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
Bend your knees or lean back to make it easier.

1191.description: A triceps extension lying with your head off the bench edge for an extra stretch.
instructions: Lie on a bench with your head just past the end, holding a weight overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your head.
Extend your arms to straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.

1255.description: A pullover on a decline bench with a barbell. It trains the chest and lats.
instructions: Lie down on a decline bench with your head lower than your hips and your feet secured.
Hold the barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the barbell in an arc motion behind your head, feeling a stretch in your chest and shoulders.
Pause for a moment, then return the barbell to the starting position by reversing the motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头部低于臀部，双脚固定。
旋前握住杠铃（手掌背向自己），双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
将手臂伸至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
以弧线动作将杠铃降低到头后，感受胸部和肩膀的伸展。
暂停片刻，然后反向动作将杠铃恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1319.description: A cable row where your palms rotate from facing down to facing up as you pull. It works the upper back, lats and biceps through a twisting path.
instructions: Attach a handle to a cable machine at waist height.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handle with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Step back to create tension on the cable, keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle towards your body, rotating your palms to face upwards as you do so.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将手柄连接到腰部高度的缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，手掌朝下。
向后退一步，在绳索上产生张力，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将手柄拉向身体，同时将手掌旋转至向上。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1383.description: A calf raise on a hack machine, pushing through the balls of your feet. It builds the calves under a supported load.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Stand on the sled machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整至舒适的重量。
站在雪橇机上，脚趾放在平台上，脚后跟悬空。
握住手柄以保持稳定性。
通过推动脚掌将脚后跟尽可能抬高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1447.description: A calf stretch on a plate-loaded lever machine, using the platform to push the heel down and lengthen the lower leg.
instructions: Set up on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform with the heel free.
Keep your knee straight and stand tall.
Let the heel sink down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.
Switch legs and repeat.

1511.description: A stretch for the back of the thigh. You reach toward your toes with a long spine and feel the hamstrings lengthen.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward with your right foot and shift your weight onto your right leg.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend forward at the hips, reaching towards your right foot with both hands.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，将重心转移到右腿上。
保持背部挺直，臀部慢慢向前弯曲，双手伸向右脚。
保持伸展动作 20-30 秒，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。

1575.description: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together. The narrow stance puts the focus on the quads.
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat against the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled by bending your knees toward your chest.
Stop before your lower back lifts off the pad.
Press through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.

1639.description: A hammer grip preacher curl with a rope on a cable. It targets the brachialis and the biceps.
instructions: Attach a rope attachment to a low pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Position your upper arms against the preacher bench pad, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the rope towards your shoulders by contracting your biceps.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the rope back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索附件连接到低滑轮缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
以中立握法（手掌相对）抓住绳子。
将上臂靠在牧师凳垫上，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
保持上臂静止，呼气并通过收缩二头肌将绳子卷向肩膀。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将绳子放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1703.description: A single-leg bend with a twist that trains balance and mobility through the hips and torso.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach across your body.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach.
Return to standing with control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

1767.description: A dip between two high parallel bars with extra weight attached. Builds triceps, chest and shoulder strength.
instructions: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your hands gripping the bars and your arms fully extended.
Bend your elbows and lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双手握住杠，双臂完全伸展。
弯曲肘部并降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后用手掌推直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1831.description: Turning your head slowly from side to side stretches the muscles around the neck. It is a gentle way to ease stiffness.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side, then to the other, as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chin level and avoid pushing into any pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1895.description: Rotates the hip in standing to stretch the glutes and deep hip muscles.
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Feel the stretch in the hip of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1959.description: A stretch with the foot raised on a support, easing the shin and top of the ankle.
instructions: Stand next to a wall and lift one foot behind you onto a low support with the top of the foot down.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg soft.
Press your hips forward gently until you feel the shin stretch.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2087.description: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles along the upper back.
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Hold it with the other arm just above the elbow.
Gently pull while rounding the upper back slightly forward.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2151.description: Rotates the arm outward against band tension to strengthen the small muscles that stabilise the shoulder.
instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the hand farther from the anchor.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

2279.description: A stationary bike session at a brisk pace, similar to running in effort, to build heart and leg endurance.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Hold the handles and sit tall.
Start pedalling at an easy pace to warm up.
Raise the speed to a brisk rhythm you can sustain.
Keep your upper body relaxed.
Continue for 10-30 minutes, then slow down to cool off.

2343.description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a bent over row, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Hold the bar and hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your spine stays long and flat, not rounded.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2407.description: A barbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your elbows still so the biceps do the work.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Place your upper arms against the arm blaster, keeping your elbows close to your torso.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂靠在手臂冲击波上，保持肘部靠近躯干。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2471.description: A floor bridge with both feet down that strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through your heels to lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2663.description: A plate-loaded high row machine that pulls from above to train the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.

2727.description: Carrying a heavy shield-like load over a distance, training core and back strength.
instructions: Lift the shield and hold it in front of you.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward at a steady pace.
Keep your posture upright.
Set it down under control when you finish.

2791.description: Curling the hand toward the forearm, working the underside of the forearm.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm up.
Curl your hand upward by bending the wrist toward your forearm.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2855.description: A face-down move kicking one heel toward the glute while the chest stays lifted.
instructions: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms.
Keep your chest lifted.
Kick one heel toward your glute twice.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips down.

2919.description: A press with the weights squeezed together, done on a Smith machine. The squeeze keeps tension on the chest throughout.
instructions: Lie on a bench under the Smith bar and hold a weight plate between your palms if you like.
Unrack the bar with a close grip and hold it over your chest.
Squeeze your hands inward as you lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Rerack the bar when done.

3175.description: A dumbbell fly with your feet lifted and knees at 90 degrees. It stretches the chest and keeps your back flat.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lift your feet so your knees are bent to 90 degrees.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out wide until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

3239.description: A kneeling plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with one hand at a time. It trains the abs and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your hands on the ground, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on your toes, and lift your body into a plank position.
Keeping your core engaged and your hips stable, lift one hand off the ground and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the ground and repeat with the other hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从跪姿开始，双手放在地上，与肩同宽。
将双腿伸到身后，用脚趾支撑，将身体抬起成平板支撑姿势。
保持核心参与并保持臀部稳定，将一只手抬离地面并拍打另一侧的肩膀。
将手放回地面并用另一只手重复此操作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3303.description: A gymnastics hold where you grip a vertical pole and hold your body out to the side. It trains the obliques, shoulders and lats.
instructions: Start by gripping a vertical pole with both hands, palms facing each other, and arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Using your core and upper body strength, raise your legs until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双手握住一根垂直杆，手掌相对，双臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
利用核心和上半身的力量，抬起双腿，直到它们与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3367.description: A single-leg squat with the free leg swept behind, like a speed skater, for leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and the foot lifted behind you.
Swing your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Lightly tap the back knee near the floor.
Stand up through the front foot, then switch legs after your reps.

3495.description: A row done lying on the floor, pulling against an anchored handle or towel, with knees bent. It works the back and biceps with no equipment.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a secure anchor, such as a towel around a sturdy post, with arms straight.
Pull your body toward your hands by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your hips on or near the floor.

3559.description: Lie face down with a towel held taut overhead, lift your chest and pull the towel toward you, training the upper back and spine.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead, holding a towel taut.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull the towel down toward your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward again with control.
Keep your neck neutral and repeat.

3623.description: Support yourself on parallel bars and lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders down.
Let your legs hang together.
Raise your legs in front of you until they are about parallel to the floor or higher.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your torso still.

3687.description: A curl where the dumbbells travel up close to your torso, dragging along your body. It keeps tension on the biceps and limits shoulder swing.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Pull your elbows back slightly and curl the weights up, keeping them close to your body.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.

3751.description: A pushup where your hands are behind you, working the triceps hard.
instructions: Sit on the floor and place your hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your hips.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.

3879.description: A lateral raise variation with a slight forward lean that hits the side delts with extra range.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, standing with a slight forward lean.
Start with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing in.
Raise your arms out and up in a slight arc until about shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and keep your wrists neutral.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Avoid swinging your torso.

3943.description: A reverse fly on a chest-supported seat using cables. It targets the rear delts with little help from momentum.
instructions: Sit facing the stack with your chest against the pad and hold the handles.
Start with your arms forward and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back to shoulder height.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

4007.description: Lie with legs raised and reach toward your heels. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie with your legs up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Lift your shoulders.
Reach one hand toward the heel.
Switch sides.
Keep your legs still.

4071.description: Front raise with your chest supported on an incline bench to reduce swinging. It isolates the front delts.
instructions: Set an incline bench and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

4135.description: A split squat with a band adding resistance for the legs.
instructions: Stand on the band in a split stance and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical.
Push back up.
Switch legs after your set.

4199.description: A deadlift with chains adding load toward lockout.
instructions: Set chains on the bar.
Grip the bar.
Brace.
Drive your feet through the floor.
Stand tall.
Lower with control.

4327.description: A leg press on a sled that moves straight up, pressing the weight vertically. It loads the thighs and glutes heavily.
instructions: Lie on your back under the sled and place your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety catches and lower the platform until your knees are deeply bent.
Keep your lower back flat on the pad.
Press the platform up without locking your knees.
Lower under control for each rep.

4391.description: A seated cable row using a rope that lets your hands travel close to your body. It targets the lats and mid back.
instructions: Sit at the low pulley with the rope attached, feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the rope ends with a neutral grip and sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your lower stomach, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.

4455.description: A back extension on an angled bench that strengthens the lower back and glutes. Hinging at the hips keeps the movement safe and smooth.
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them behind your head.
Lower your torso with a straight spine until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso by squeezing your glutes and lower back.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Avoid over-arching at the top.

4583.description: A powerful straight punch from the rear hand, driven by the hips and thrown at a bag.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the bag.
Rotate your shoulder and keep your chin tucked.
Keep your lead hand up to guard.
Snap back to your stance and repeat.

4711.description: A jumping jack variation where the arms and legs cross over each other.
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart while the arms swing overhead.
Jump and cross one foot in front and the arms across your chest.
Alternate which side crosses.
Keep a quick but controlled pace.

4775.description: A combined move on parallel bars that pairs a push-up with a dip. It works the chest and triceps.
instructions: Place hands on parallel bars and support yourself in a plank.
Lower into a push-up with your elbows out.
Press back up to a plank.
Shift your hands to the edge of the bars, body upright.
Dip down and press up, then repeat the cycle.

4839.description: A dead bug with a band around the feet that adds resistance for the legs. It trains the lower abs and anti-extension control.
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your feet and legs bent over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend one leg away against the band.
Return it and switch legs.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.

4903.description: A seated hamstring curl using a resistance band anchored in front of you. It isolates the back of the thigh.
instructions: Anchor the band at foot height and sit facing it.
Loop the band around your heels.
Extend your legs straight in front of you.
Curl your heels back under the seat against the tension.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the end.
Return slowly without letting the band snap.

4967.description: A form check drawing for the lateral raise, showing correct and incorrect technique. It reminds you how to train the side delts safely.
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Compare with the incorrect position to correct your form.

5031.description: Leg raise gripping a medicine ball between your feet. The extra load makes the lower abs work harder.
instructions: Lie on your back with a medicine ball squeezed between your feet.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your grip on the ball firm.

5095.description: Lunge while holding one dumbbell overhead. The one-sided load challenges balance and trunk stability.
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and lock it out.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

5159.description: A straight-arm plank held on the hands. It builds trunk stiffness and shoulder stability.
instructions: Place your hands under your shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips so the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower your knees.

5223.description: A shrug on the Smith machine with a wide grip. It builds the upper traps.
instructions: Set the bar at thigh height and grip it wider than shoulder width.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

5287.description: The full clean lifts the barbell from the floor to the shoulders while dropping into a front squat. It builds explosive power.
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside your knees.
Pull the bar explosively with a flat back.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a front squat.
Stand up fully.
Lower the bar with control to the floor.

5479.description: Pull-up using a narrow overhand grip to emphasise the lower lats and arms.
instructions: Grip the bar with hands a few centimetres apart, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and engage your shoulders.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.

5607.description: Face pull using a band to train the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your face, elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

5671.description: A one-leg glute bridge with the knee kept forward. Works each glute on its own and tests hip balance.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your standing shin close to vertical.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips until in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

5863.description: Hold a kettlebell overhead in one hand and lower it behind your head. It isolates one triceps at a time.
instructions: Stand tall with a kettlebell held overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending the elbow.
Straighten your arm back to the top.
Switch sides after your set.

5991.description: A mirror drill where you shuffle sideways in response to a partner, training lateral quickness and reaction.
instructions: Face a partner about 2 yards away in an athletic stance.
Have your partner move left or right.
Shuffle sideways to mirror them without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and chest up.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then swap roles.

6055.description: A seated rotation holding a bottle. It works the obliques and deep core.
instructions: Sit on the floor, knees bent, and lean back a little with a straight spine.
Hold a bottle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the bottle near the floor.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your feet down or lifted for more challenge.

6439.description: Raising one arm forward against band tension. It trains the front of the shoulder with smooth control.
instructions: Stand on the band with one foot and hold the handle at your thigh, palm down.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Raise the arm forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the band tension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6759.description: A seated press with the front of the foot to train the shin muscle. It helps balance the lower leg.
instructions: Sit tall with your heels on the floor.
Lift the toes of one foot as high as you can.
Press them up against light resistance such as the other foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

7207.description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot elevated and a band adding resistance.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench, band under your front foot and held at your shoulders.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Keep your torso tall.
Press through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7463.description: Mountain climber where each knee drives toward the same-side elbow, adding side work for the core.
instructions: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the outside of your elbow.
Return that foot and switch legs.
Keep your hips low and your core braced.
Move at a quick, controlled pace.

7591.description: A face pull performed lying on your back with a cable. It hits the rear delts and upper back with little help from momentum.
instructions: Lie on your back with the cable set low behind your head and hold the rope ends.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring out and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

8423.description: A seated lean back that wakes up the abs by holding the torso against gravity.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lean back slowly while keeping your back straight.
Stop where you can still hold your form, then return to upright using your abs.

8615.description: A seated dynamic stretch that opens the chest by alternating arms.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open one arm out to the side and rotate the trunk slightly.
Feel the stretch across your chest.
Return and switch arms in a smooth rhythm.

9319.description: A gentler dragon flag lowering with your knees bent. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Lift your hips and tuck your knees.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly with bent knees.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and repeat.

9511.description: A pull-up with your feet on a box for light assistance. It helps you build up to full pull-ups.
instructions: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one or both feet on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Use your legs as little as possible.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

9703.description: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. It removes leg drive and challenges the core.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and hold a kettlebell at your shoulder.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

10535.description: Press the top of your foot upward against resistance while seated. It strengthens the shin muscle.
instructions: Sit with one foot resting flat and the other leg crossed over it.
Hook the toes of the lower foot under your other foot for light resistance.
Lift the toes and forefoot up toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

10663.description: A gymnastic move where you rotate backward through the rings. It builds shoulder mobility and control.
instructions: Hang from the rings with a firm grip.
Tuck your knees and lift your hips overhead.
Rotate backward, passing your legs between your arms.
Lower your feet toward the floor until you stretch your shoulders.
Pause, then reverse the motion with control.
Move slowly and stop if you feel pinching.

10855.description: A reformer move pulling the straps behind you. It opens the chest and works the upper back.
instructions: Kneel facing the straps with your torso upright.
Hold the straps with straight arms.
Pull the straps back behind your body.
Turn your head gently to each side.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your chest lifted and ribs down.

10919.description: A second version of the side-to-side seated foot move for ankle mobility.
instructions: Sit tall and lift one foot a little off the floor.
Keep your leg still.
Sweep the foot to the inside, then to the outside.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat, then switch feet.

11047.description: A side-lying leg raise that targets the outer hip. It is a simple way to strengthen the muscles that keep your pelvis steady.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Rest your head on your lower arm and keep your hips stacked.
Lift your top leg up and slightly back without rolling your torso.
Pause at the top, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then roll over and do the other side.

11303.description: A squat on the Smith machine to a bench. The bench gives you a consistent depth and a stable path.
instructions: Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back.
Unrack and step your feet slightly forward.
Sit down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

11879.description: A step-up with a Smith machine bar across your back for loaded leg work.
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back and stand in front of a bench.
Place one foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up fully.
Step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

0039.description: A front squat holding the bar at the front of the chest. Trains the quads, glutes and core.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell in front of your chest with your hands shoulder-width apart, elbows pointing forward.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在胸前，双手与肩同宽，肘部向前。
当你将身体降低到蹲姿时，收紧核心并保持挺胸，将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0103.description: A standing roll-out with the barbell. Requires strong abs and a firm back.
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Engage your core and slowly roll the barbell down towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your arms extended.
Continue rolling the barbell forward until your body is fully extended and your hands are directly above your head.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the barbell back towards your thighs, maintaining control and keeping your core engaged.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，双手握住杠铃于大腿前方。
启动你的核心肌群，慢慢地将杠铃向地面滚动，保持背部挺直，手臂伸展。
继续向前滚动杠铃，直到身体完全伸展，双手位于头顶正上方。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃向大腿方向滚动，保持控制并保持核心参与。
重复所需的重复次数。

0167.description: A kneeling high cable row. Targets the upper back and rear delts.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a cable machine at chest height.
Kneel down in front of the cable machine and grab the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Sit back on your heels, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the bar towards your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到胸部高度的缆绳机上。
跪在缆绳机前，用正握方式抓住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
坐在脚后跟上，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将杠铃拉向上腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开杠铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0231.description: A one-arm cable triceps extension from a standing position. You bend and straighten the elbow while keeping the upper arm still.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine.
Hold the cable handle with your right hand, palm facing down, and position your arm so that it is fully extended and parallel to the ground.
Keep your elbow stationary and close to your body.
Slowly bend your elbow, lowering the cable handle towards the back of your head.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then extend your arm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform the exercise with your left arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，面向绳索机。
用右手握住电缆手柄，掌心朝下，调整手臂位置，使其完全伸展并与地面平行。
保持肘部静止并靠近身体。
慢慢弯曲肘部，将电缆手柄向脑后降低。
在动作底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边并用左臂进行练习。

0295.description: A dumbbell clean where you explode up and catch the weights at the shoulders. It builds power in the hips, legs and back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees and lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively extend your hips and knees, driving through your heels to jump off the ground.
As you jump, shrug your shoulders and pull the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping them close to your body.
Catch the dumbbells at shoulder height, with your elbows pointing forward and your palms facing up.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
弯曲膝盖，降低臀部至下蹲位置，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
爆发性地伸展臀部和膝盖，通过脚后跟跳离地面。
当你跳跃时，耸肩并将哑铃拉向你的肩膀，保持它们靠近你的身体。
在与肩同高的位置抓住哑铃，肘部向前，手掌朝上。
通过反向运动将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0359.description: Braced on a support, you raise one dumbbell out to the side with a bent torso. It targets the rear shoulder and upper back, one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing inwards.
Lean forward and place your free hand on the bench for support.
Keep your arm slightly bent and raise it out to the side until it is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝内。
身体前倾，将空着的手放在长凳上以获得支撑。
保持手臂稍微弯曲并将其向侧面抬起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0423.description: Standing, you extend one arm overhead with a dumbbell, bending and straightening the elbow. It works the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Keep your upper arm close to your head and perpendicular to the ground.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head, bending your elbow.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
保持上臂靠近头部并垂直于地面。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，弯曲肘部。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0487.description: A reverse crunch that lifts the hips while the legs rise over the torso. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs lifted and knees bent.
Place your hands at your sides or under your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid using momentum.

0551.description: A Turkish get up where you come up through a squat style transition while keeping the kettlebell overhead. Trains full body control, stability and strength.
instructions: Start by lying on your back with your legs extended and the kettlebell held in your right hand, arm fully extended above your shoulder.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot flat on the ground, keeping your left leg extended.
Pressing through your right foot, lift your hips off the ground, coming into a bridge position.
Slide your left leg underneath your body, bending your left knee and placing your left foot flat on the ground.
Rotate your torso to the left, bringing your left hand to the ground for support.
Pressing through your right foot and left hand, lift your torso off the ground, coming into a kneeling position.
From the kneeling position, stand up, keeping the kettlebell extended overhead.
Reverse the movement to return to the starting position.
Repeat the exercise on the other side, starting with the kettlebell in your left hand.
instructionsZh: 首先仰卧，双腿伸展，右手握住壶铃，手臂完全伸展到肩膀上方。
弯曲右膝，将右脚平放在地面上，保持左腿伸展。
压右脚，将臀部抬离地面，进入桥位。
将左腿滑到身体下方，弯曲左膝并将左脚平放在地面上。
将躯干向左旋转，将左手放在地面上以获得支撑。
压右脚和左手，将躯干抬离地面，形成跪姿。
从跪姿站起来，保持壶铃伸过头顶。
反向运动以返回到起始位置。
从左手的壶铃开始，在另一侧重复练习。

0615.description: Lying on your back, you cross one leg over the other. It stretches the outer hip and lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and bring it across your body.
Let it lower toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

0679.description: A slow bridge where you roll up and down your spine. It strengthens the abs and glutes and improves spinal control.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Curl your pelvis up and peel your spine off the floor.
Lift to a bridge position.
Pause at the top.
Roll back down one vertebra at a time.
Move slowly and breathe.

0743.description: On a sled machine, you squat with your back against the pad. Works the quads and glutes.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable position for your height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Hold onto the handles or bars for stability.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整到适合您身高的舒适位置。
双脚与肩同宽站立在平台上，脚趾稍微向外。
握住手柄或杆以保持稳定性。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或略低于地面。
暂停片刻，然后用脚后跟将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0807.description: A hanging reverse crunch, curling the knees and pelvis up toward the chest. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees up towards your chest, curling your pelvis towards your ribcage.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your knees back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心肌群，将膝盖抬向胸部，将骨盆卷向胸腔。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0871.description: A crunch that pulls the knees toward the chest as the upper body curls up. It trains the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulder blades off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest, simultaneously curling your upper body towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your shoulder blades and extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部，同时将上半身卷向膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低肩胛骨并将双腿伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0935.description: Rotate your forearm outward against a band while the elbow stays at your side. It strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles that steady the shoulder.
instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it, holding the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm away from your belly, keeping the elbow pinned in place.
Pause when your hand points slightly outward, then return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

0999.description: A single-leg calf raise with a band around the foot. It trains the calves.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your left foot.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Slowly raise your left heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your left heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the right leg.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将弹力带绕在左脚掌上。
如果需要，请抓住一个稳定的物体以保持平衡。
慢慢地将左脚跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将左脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换右腿。
